other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage in Cross-Validation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes out-of-fold (OOF) target encodings and Ridge model predictions to use as features, but then reuses the exact same K-Fold splits to train and evaluate the final models. Because of this, the OOF features for the training folds were generated using the targets of the validation fold. This leaks the validation targets into the training features, leading to severe overfitting and overly optimistic validation scores.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature Leakage during Cross-Validation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates group-wise aggregations (such as the mean and standard deviation of numerical columns grouped by categorical columns) over the entire training dataset before performing cross-validation. This leaks the feature distributions of the validation folds into the training folds.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated solution with extensive feature engineering, deep learning, and optimized ensembling that correctly avoids leaking the holdout test set. However, a critical target leakage flaw occurs internally during cross-validation: the agent re-uses the identical K-Fold splits for generating out-of-fold features (target encoding and stacking) and for final model training, causing validation targets to leak into the training features.
